en: It is a riot! Mayhem!\nCondominium!
I think you mean\npandemonium.
So, what happened?
A <font color=green>swarm</font> of those\nmulticolored <font color=green>wriggly</font> things\nare <font color=green>lurking</font> about!
Get to the point already!
Ooh, forgive me... <font color=green>*fidget*</font>
*Grumble*

Oh, you will service me
with some premium oil?
Then I will do my best to
give a full report!
Always out for yourself,\naren't you?

Massive swarms of gerels
and their sub-species
have been sighted on
several planets in this
sector!
Massive swarms? Just\nhow massive?
Like THIS massive...
Eeew, gross...

Unless we do something,
the surrounding planets
will swamped by gerels,
transforming them into a
whole rainbow of colors!
We better act quick\nbefore anyone gets hurt!
Why are they swarming?
Hey, a little extra color\nisn't necessarily a bad\nthing!
I see... The inhabitants of\nthose planets must be in\ndire straits.
*Mumble*

As of now, the cause of
their swarming is unclear.
However, it is most
definitely an anomaly.
The gerels are multiplying\nas we speak.
We can investigate the\ncause later. But first we\nhave to take them out.
Hm...
Do you want to fill this\nsector with gerel-colored\nplanets!?
It would make flying the\nship in this sector quite\ndifficult on the eyes.

See!? Do you want to
make Coro accidentally
crash the ship into a
gerel-infested planet?

We would be <font color=green>plopped</font>
down into a <font color=green>viscous</font> sea of
their icky body secretions!
Just thinking about it
sends a <font color=green>shiver</font> down my
spine!

See, you've said
something so disturbing
that even Evelysse is
starting to speak weirdly...

In any case, we have to
act quick! Coro, calculate
which planets are
suffering the worst!

Roger that. I will change
course as soon as I
detect a negatively
impacted planet.

I must also inform you
that the swarming gerels
are of the variety with
attacks that cause
paralysis. Please be
careful when engaging
them.
Impressive, Captain! You\nare a veritable\ngerel-subduing machine!

I am not detecting any
other planets being
negatively impacted by
gerels.
Hmm...
Now that we've wiped out\nthe gerel threat, any ideas\nabout their origin?
Yes, about that... It seems\nthere is a wormhole.

And massive swarms of
gerels have been
observed streaming
through it.
Ngh!?
But no need to worry! The\nwormhole is closed at the\nmoment, however...
However what? Out with it\nalready.
Unnatural distortions in\nthe fabric of space-time\nare still observable.
As such, the gerel swarms\nmay just be a precursor\nof something yet to come.
A precursor!? You mean\nsomething else bad's going\nto happen?

I cannot say for sure.
There are no precedents
for such a phenomenon
anywhere in my database.
*Grumble*
I see. I will continue to\nmonitor the situation.

Well, we don't even know
enough about this to be
concerned about it yet.
The imminent gerel threat
has been dealt with, so
let's move on.
Roger that. I will return\nthe ship to our previously\nplanned course.
